$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services-emergency pack composed with a flat-rate plumber content seed (Straight Pipe Plumbing, Pasadena), re-registered in the jacaranda register with its own page skeletons. Everything structural — builders, routes, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Plumber & emergency
description: A flat-rate trade site lettered like an LA sign painter's van door: a full-bleed photo of the owner on the job with the headline painted in cream show-card caps and brush script, the prices hand-lettered on a menu board right on the photo, and a painted on-call roundel. Under it the measured numbers, a signed job report where the quote matches the final, how-it-works as the customer's real text thread, reviews, the neighborhoods, and the call — call-first on every page, with a quote form and booking for everything that can wait.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins).

types.name: Scheduled repair visit
types.description: For a drip, a slow drain, or a running toilet — anything that can wait for a time that suits you.

types.name: Flat-quote walkthrough
types.description: For bigger jobs — a water heater, a repipe, a bathroom. We look, then text you one flat price.

theme.$comment: The jacaranda register's sign red, pinned as the brand so the app surfaces match the marketing pages: a red deep enough for cream button letters (AA) on the cream board ground, and a neon-lifted red for the night sheet. navigation declares the inline bar (a declared theme variant outranks the shared shell's split bar): the contained card, the call a painted red board.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (web/app/src/View/ServicesEmergency/ServicesEmergencyPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig). pages seeds each page's layout skeleton — ids match servicesEmergencyLanding.ts; the platform's structural editor edits these. The preset is jacaranda (LA sign-painter vernacular: cream board ground, jacaranda-purple ink, Luckiest Guy show-card caps with a brush-script accent word, painted outlines and drop shades) under the catalog's sign-red brand. Home runs the flat-rate argument in order: the full-bleed photo hero with the painted headline, the on-call roundel, and the price board on the photograph; the measured-numbers strip; a signed job report; how-it-works as the customer's text thread; then reviews, the neighborhoods, and the call. The full price book and the services live on /services.
